body:
🌟 Welcome to Kirovsk SMP! 🌟

🔥 Pure Vanilla Survival — No Land Claims, No Protection Plugins! 🔥

We are a server for those who miss the real Minecraft without restrictions.
Here you won’t find:
❌ Land claims
❌ /sethome, /tpa or any teleport commands
❌ Region protection
❌ Shops, donation perks, or custom game-altering features

✅ Just pure vanilla on the latest version
✅ Complete freedom to build and interact
✅ Economy, politics, friendships — everything is player-driven
✅ Land is protected by trust, agreements, and an active community

---

🌍 How does it work?

We believe that the best protection is a healthy community.
On our server you can:

· Build anywhere, in any style
· Form settlements and nations
· Engage in trade, politics, building, or just exploring
· Create farms, redstone contraptions, and large-scale projects

However, remember: if you don’t take care of your own belongings, no plugin will do it for you. Griefing is prohibited by the rules and will be punished, but the safety of your builds largely depends on your own caution and the people around you.

---

🛡️ Who is this server for?

For players who:

· Are tired of “hub” servers with dozens of plugins
· Want to experience the true spirit of classic SMP
· Prefer negotiating and cooperating over simply locking a chest
· Value a world where every player leaves their mark

---

👥 We are looking for moderators who share our values!

If you:
✔️ Love vanilla Minecraft
✔️ Know how to resolve conflicts without relying on land claims or admin commands
✔️ Are ready to help players, enforce rules, and maintain a friendly atmosphere
✔️ Want to be part of a close‑knit team

Then we’d love to hear from you! 🙌

---

🎮 How to join?

➡️ IP and all the info are in our Discord (link provided)
➡️ Whitelist? No — free entry, but rules must be followed

---

✨ Kirovsk SMP — a place where people matter more than plugins. Join us! ✨
